central_belt_linlithgow_steward.text: Welcome to Linlithgow Palace. The roof is missing, so the weather comes free with the tour.
Mary, Queen of Scots, was born here on 8 December 1542. Her father, James V, was born here too.
The courtyard fountain dates from around 1538 and is among the finest in Scotland.
The palace burned in 1746, reportedly by accident, while government troops were staying here. Nobody has put the roof back since.

central_belt_linlithgow_visitor.text: The loch below is Linlithgow Loch. Swans, ducks and a heron who watches me eat. Stalklets stand still in the shallows pretending to be sticks.
